Let f(k) = number of k-bit integers (leading 1) with more 1s than 0s. With the leading 1 fixed, among the other k-1 bits we need j ones with 1+j > k-1-j, i.e. j >= floor(k/2).
- k = 2m+1 odd: f = sum_{j>=m} C(2m,j) = (4^m + C(2m,m))/2.
- k = 2m+2 even: f = sum_{j>=m+1} C(2m+1,j) = 4^m.
Values k=1..19: 1,1,3,4,11,16,42,64,163,256,638,1024,2510,4096,9908,16384,39203,65536,155382. Even k sum = (4^9-1)/3 = 87381; odd k sum = 207861; total for all numbers < 2^19: 295242.

20-bit numbers 2^19 <= n <= 1,000,000 = 11110100001001000000_2 (bits set at 19,18,17,16,14,9,6); need >=11 ones. Digit walk along N, branching where N has a 1 by placing a 0 and freeing the remaining bits:
